The '''k'Farri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Great Rim Route]] within the [[Hapan Rim Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system got it's name from the planet [[k'Farri]] which was situated within it.

==Behind the scenes==
The k'Farri system's first and only appearance was in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' on page 136.<ref name="TEA" />
